state_rule: Configuration state is derived from clean Git HEAD plus CAD manifest. Dirty controlled worktree cannot produce PASS.
change_rule: Normal changes occur on a branch with one minimal transaction record. Added files must be named exactly in new_files. PR merge is human authorization.
close_rule: Close = required checks PASS + PR merge + clean main + checkpoint tag.
center_rule: Center is a read-only projection and must show STALE if its Git HEAD differs from actual repository HEAD.
